name: The Twilight Threat
summary: Farholde seeks Stormwind's help against a sudden rise in Twilight's Hammer activity. You carry evidence to Bolvar Fordragon, though the Alliance has other wars to reckon with.

sections.title: Farholde's Plea
sections.body: Farholde's people turn to you after Lady Amberhall hears of your dealings with the Twilight's Hammer. Their campaign began to drive the Horde from their homeland, but cultist activity has sharply increased. They fear Stormwind will not answer their pleas before Farholde faces enemies on two fronts. You carry evidence to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.

sections.title: Stormwind's Answer
sections.body: In Stormwind Keep, Bolvar Fordragon hears the warning from Farholde. He says the Alliance is already at war on a much wider scale and cannot spend its strength on one hamlet's private feud. More homes have been razed by the Horde than those in the Riverglades. Bolvar sees little hope that Brant will set aside his pride and bring his cavalry to the Alliance's aid.

faq.answer: Farholde asks Stormwind for help as Twilight's Hammer activity rises.
Farholde fears it will be overwhelmed by enemies on two fronts if Stormwind does not hear its pleas.
You carry Kilgar's Head to Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind Keep.
Bolvar Fordragon receives news from Farholde, whose campaign began to remove the Horde from its homeland.
Bolvar says the Alliance is fighting on a much larger scale and lacks the resources to support Farholde's personal feud.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer, you carry Farholde's evidence to Bolvar Fordragon while its people seek aid against the Twilight's Hammer and the Horde.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Twilight Threat
